open_points.subject: activate-flow authorization
open_points.text: State 4 says “the owner or any agent asks to activate, an agent only a `read` version (A16 rule 3, A06)”, while A16 now says any agent may “call activate on a flow” and A06 refuses an agent’s version above `read` as the operation’s own refusal, distinct from `not_permitted`.
open_points.question: May an agent call activation for an effectful flow and receive A06’s operation-level `refused`, or must `surface` reject the call as `not_permitted`?
options: Any agent may call activate; `flows` returns `refused` for an effectful version
Only the owner may call activate for an effectful version; `surface` returns `not_permitted`
open_points.default_guess: Any agent may call activate, and `flows` returns the operation-level `refused` result for an effectful version.
